# openmetadata_learning_resource (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata learning resource by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_learning_resource" "data_governance_101" {
  fully_qualified_name = "data_governance_101"
}

output "data_governance_101_categories" {
  value = data.openmetadata_learning_resource.data_governance_101.categories
}

output "data_governance_101_source_url" {
  value = data.openmetadata_learning_resource.data_governance_101.source[0].url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Learning resource fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Learning resource UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (List of String) Academy categories the resource belongs to.
- `contexts` (Attributes List) UI contexts the resource appears in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contexts))
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `difficulty` (String) Difficulty level, one of Intro, Intermediate or Advanced.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `estimated_duration` (Number) Estimated time to finish the resource, in minutes.
- `name` (String) Learning resource name.
- `resource_type` (String) Content type, one of Article, Video or Storylane.
- `source` (Attributes List) Location of the content. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `status` (String) Publication status, one of Active, Draft or Deprecated.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

<a id="nestedatt--contexts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contexts`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (String) Component on the page the resource is attached to.
- `page_id` (String) Page the resource is shown on.
- `priority` (Number) Ordering priority inside the context.


<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Read-Only:

- `provider` (String) System that provides the content.
- `url` (String) URL of the content.
